data.name: Somvansh
data.gender_notes: Somvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Somvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Som' (Sun) and 'Vansh' (seed). It signifies the seed of the Sun and represents the idea of growth and prosperity. It is believed that a child named Somvansh will bring sunshine into the family and ensure its continued growth and prosperity. The name Somvansh carries the meaning “Sun's seed” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Somvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody sun's seed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Somvansh is a divine name that represents the continuity of life and the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth. It is believed that the name carries the blessings of the Sun God and bestows upon the child the qualities of courage, wisdom, and leadership.
data.etymology: Somvansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun's seed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Somvansh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

By invoking the name of the Sun, Somvansh is believed to embody these qualities and bring positivity and success to the family and community.

It is believed that every soul is a seed, planted by the cosmic creator, and has the potential to grow and blossom into its highest potential.
